Sunday, August 16, 2015
Kickoff: 2PM
Royal Brougham Park (CenturyLink Field)
Seattle, WA

By Tom Biro

I'll just get this out of the way now. Before you think that being a Sounders supporter is the worst thing you could be doing this summer, it's not. Not by a long shot.

It's been a tough few months in Soundersland, for certain, but this is when we have the opportunity to show our mettle. To show what we believe. To lose ourselves, once again, in supporting the club we love. Also, we haven't lost 15-1 yet, so there's that.

The club has been busy. We have new additions. While adding three (four, if you cound Friberg) players to a roster mid-season isn't always the stuff of legends, it's important to note that the seriously slipping New England Revolution added Jermaine Jones to the club last August, and proceeded to win 9 more matches and make the MLS Cup Final. We have seen unexpected things before. Sounders have done these things before.

On Sunday afternoon, Orlando City SC comes to RBP for the first time, with the surprising Cyle Larin and fan fave Kaká in tow. They are used to playing in front of big crowds at home, and the weather will not likely faze them. They, too, have had a not-so-great run during which they've earned five points in seven matches.

Things will look different on Sunday, with Clint Dempsey most likely out with an injury, and three new additions - Ivanschitz, Valdez and Torres - probably in the 18. Brad Evans is expected to be back in the midfield. Someone will likely have a new hairstyle. Do not panic. 

We know the players hear us. They have told us so. 

"I'm going to choose them as one of the best fans. I've played for a lot of clubs and it's different here. They're friendly and really support the team, which is good. I like that."

- Obafemi Martins, March 2013

Be those supporters on Sunday. Let them hear us.
